target: behavioral receipt addition for the five Syne-owned skill adaptations

lens_results.evidence: Receipts are inert JSON/Markdown; the oracle performs bounded local reads and assertions only.
Each claimed skill has one exact prompt, digest binding, observed result, evidence class, and limitation; executable assertions cover the workflow-specific invariants.
No credential, token, prompt body, rollout path, or authorization secret is stored; publication and activation remain separate gates.

Removed the absolute host path and live per-request token counters from the public receipt; exact telemetry remains only in the local staging evidence and is neither copied nor fingerprinted in the PR.
Uses repository-native unittest discovery, JSON fixtures, pathlib, and deterministic SHA-256 binding for public candidate files.
Seven behavioral-oracle tests cover scope, exact candidate digests, design alternatives, develop gates, wheel yielding, token privacy, and skill-forge publication/activation separation.

verified_findings.title: Public behavioral receipt included unnecessary local-path and session-usage detail
verified_findings.remedy: Use repository-relative/worktree-class descriptions and retain only the supported aggregate field names in the public fixture.

residual_limits: The review is six explicitly separated coordinator passes, not six independent agents.
The instruction-only forward exercises are same-coordinator evidence.
GitHub Actions has not produced a run for the draft PR; local validation is not represented as remote CI.
completion_receipt: Lens coverage: Safety ✓ · Design ✓ · Security ✓ · Privacy ✓ · Idiomacy ✓ · Tests ✓ (single-coordinator degraded)
